scoring: The straight exhibit plan keeps the 96 mm stride and all plantar and trunk waypoints. Its reference time and swing/stance clock are divided by the cadence multiplier. Physics, actuator limits, judge thresholds and neck-gesture timing are unchanged. Walk speed is net displacement divided by elapsed time less the two standing holds. Force and elbow RMS cover the steady sequence following two setup swings. Balance and contact sequence are judged across the entire trial. Each 10 ms force peak averages ten consecutive 1 kHz samples on a single foot. C1 checks posture and numerical health, C2 progress/drift, C3 a minimum 10 mm support margin, C4 ordered unloaded swings and three loaded stance feet, C5c at most 10 mm contact slide and C6 at most 1% actuator saturation.
